init_distrib_slurm: initialize torch distributed process group using SLURM environment variables and a TCP store
rank0_only: use the rank0_only decorator to restrict function execution to world rank 0 only
gatherv: gather variable-sized 1D tensors from all ranks into a single rank using ring all-gather
gather_objects: gather arbitrary Python objects from all distributed ranks to a single output rank
save_resume_state: save checkpoint state to a file for resuming preempted SLURM jobs later
